findings.body: An authenticated activity without `conversation.conversationType` refreshes the saved route to `conversationType: null`, a case the new transport tests explicitly accept. Subsequent delivery with a Gantry thread ID then omits `;messageid=<root>` from the destination. Microsoft's [SDK documentation](https://microsoft.github.io/teams-sdk/blog/quoted-and-threaded-replies/) confirms that `replyToId` does not control threading, so text, cards and card updates can target the wrong conversation or fail after this refresh. Construct the threaded destination whenever a thread ID is supplied, following the SDK's conversation-independent threading behavior.
findings.title: [P2] Preserve thread targeting when conversation type is absent
